annotations.title: Has this input cost reached the company's margin?

description: Use when the user asks whether a commodity shock (cocoa, coffee, sugar, wheat, corn, beef, aluminum, crude oil) has squeezed a public company's margin, whether it passed the cost through, or what a price spike will do to a supplier. Returns the commodity's average price change and the company's gross margin for each fiscal year since 2019, with a verdict: squeezed, held, or widened. Refuses before you are charged if the commodity moved less than 25%. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: built in: fiscal years since 2019; segment: commodity. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For where US imports of a product come from, use run_trade_concentration.
